QuestInfo.name: Eliminate the Stone Golems
QuestInfo.0: Muirhat is worried about the evil spirits that have infiltrated Victoria Island as of late. I wonder what I could do to help. I should go talk to Muirhat on the top deck of The Nautilus.
QuestInfo.1: Victoria Island is infested with evil spirits, but you can't give up. You need to eliminate #r20 Stone Golems#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their wickedness in Victoria Island.  \n\n#o 5130101# #r#a21981##k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated 20 Stone Golems and can only hope that you've made a difference in Victoria Island.

0.0: 오랜만일세. 어쩐일로 나를 찾아왔나? 흐음… 내가 요새 그렇게 표정이 좋지 못하였나. 내가 근심이 많아 보인다는 소문이 퍼져서 멀리 있던 자네까지 찾아오게 하다니… 후…
0.1: 다름이 아니라 검은 마법사의 악의 기운이 빅토리아 아일랜드 깊은 곳까지 스며들어서 걱정이 많다네. 자네라면 날 도와서 섬의 깊은 곳까지 가서 악의 기운이 더 이상 퍼지지 않도록 할 수 있을 것 같은데… 이곳까지 찾아온 김에 날 도와주게.

yes.0: 고맙군. 그렇다면 우선 스톤골렘을 해치워주게. 돌처럼 단단한 녀석들이라 요새 애먹고 있네. #r스톤골렘 100마리#k를 해치워 나에게 돌아오면 후하게 보답해주지. 하하.

no.0: 다른 일이 많나 보군. 어쩔 수 없지. 다른 용사들을 찾아봐야겠군.

0.0: It has been a while. What brought you here? Hmmm... Do I really have that look of concern? Everyone has been talking about how I seem to be in distress. I guess the words reached far enough that you made your way here... sigh...
0.1: What it is, is that the evil spirits of the Black Mage penetrated deep into Victoria Island, and that concerns me a lot. I feel that you may be capable of helping me stop the spreading of the evil spirits reaching the deepest part of the island. Will you help me do that?

yes.0: Thank you. First, you should defeat the Stone Golems. Their skins are hard as rocks, so they are quite a nuisance. I will give you a great reward if you come see me after you have defeated #r20 Stone Golems#k. Haha! You can do it!

no.0: You must be busy with other endeavors. That's unfortunate. I'll just have to look for other willing warriors.

1.0: That was fast. I knew you'd be able to do it. Hopefully your efforts will result in bringing in peace on Victoria Island.

yes.0: Once you make yourself more powerful, I'll contact you again for more help.

mob.0: Eliminate 20 Stone Golems. They are hiding deep within Victoria Island.
